subject: Interview follow-up: reconcile evaluator notes & behavioral anchors
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Interview follow-up: reconcile evaluator notes & behavioral anchors

Hi all,

Thanks again for the loop on Alexei (onsite yesterday). I pulled the partial rubrics — we have full numeric entries from Marissa but Jonas and Laura, your numeric columns are blank in Greenhouse and there are a few missing behavioral-anchor comments that I want to capture before we close the packet.

Two asks: 1) If you haven’t completed the numeric rubric, please paste quick anchors (3 bullets max) under the \"behavioral anchors\" section in the shared doc below by 3pm PT today. Even a short line like \"Shows pragmatic tradeoffs in system design; needs follow-up on latency/consistency\" is fine. 2) If you see contradiction between competency vs system-design ratings, flag the specific question so we can align.

Link to shared capture: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBxyz-interview-anchors
Greenhouse: https://greenhouse.io/candidates/GR-12345

Attachment: alexei_romanov_resume.pdf (pdf)

I'll synthesize a one-page summary after I have the anchors and call for an informal straw poll. If you think we should escalate to a calibration sync instead of poll, say so.

—Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Engineering Manager, Hiring Committee
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 10:10:24 -0700
Subject: Re: Interview follow-up: reconcile evaluator notes & behavioral anchors

Rafael — thanks for the nudge. I uploaded my completed rubric (see attachment) and pasted my behavioral anchors into the doc. Quick summary from my side:

- Communication: Clear, structured thought; asked clarifying questions when assumptions were missing.
- Product sense: Good prioritization rationale; level-appropriate.
- System design: Tended toward breadth rather than deep tradeoff justification; follow-up needed on KV cache invalidation strategy.

I see Jonas and Laura are missing numeric entries in Greenhouse. Jonas — if you can either finish numbers or drop 2–3 anchor bullets here that would be enough for my synthesis. Laura — same ask.

If it helps, I created a tiny three-option poll in the doc so we can capture a quick lean: [Strong hire, Hire with concerns, No hire]. I'll leave it open until 4:30pm PT.

Attachment: marissa_rubric_alexei.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Staff PM (Hiring Partner)
Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — quick consolidation from my side after reading the anchors and Marissa's rubric. Results from the doc poll (closed at 4:30pm PT):

- Marissa: Strong hire
- Jonas: Hire with concerns
- Laura: Hire with concerns
- Rafael (I captured your lean verbally): No hire (per your earlier comment in the standup) — Rafael, confirm and I can update the packet accordingly if that was your final stance.

Net: majority lean = Hire with concerns. Proposed next steps:

1) Rafael / Hiring manager to decide whether to move candidate to final take-home design task (suggested) or stop here.
2) If moving forward, Talent Ops to request two references and schedule a 60–90 minute design write-up review with a senior infra lead.
3) I attached a one-page consolidated summary that includes the three anchors and a short reconciliation note (consolidated_interview_summary_alexei.docx).

If we keep moving, let's also capture the specific follow-up questions for the write-up: cache invalidation approach, memory and KV-cache eviction under multi-tenant routing, and expected SLO tradeoffs. Rafael — please confirm whether you want me to schedule the calibration with Hiring Manager + Senior Infra or if you'd prefer to handle it directly.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Talent (Hiring Committee)
Redwood Inference
